selected.title: fix(artifacts): complete positional ZIP reads
selected.author: Afloat16
selected.summary_en: Complete short positional ZIP reads and report premature EOF as an integrity failure.
selected.summary_zh: 补全ZIP定位读取中的短读，并将提前EOF明确报告为完整性错误。
selected.technical_value: Accumulates FileHandle.read results using consistent buffer and file offsets until the admitted read is complete; a zero-byte read before completion raises the existing integrity failure. Final merged tests inject short reads into real descriptors while exercising production ZIP enumeration and extraction.
selected.technical_value_zh: 按一致的缓冲区与文件偏移累积FileHandle.read结果，直到读满已允许的范围；若提前返回0字节，则使用既有完整性错误。合并测试在真实文件描述符上注入短读，调用生产ZIP枚举与解压路径。
selected.limitations: Archive-reader correctness within existing allocation/read budgets; no throughput or expanded security-boundary claim. Cancellation coverage proves no entry is published after cancellation, not necessarily that every underlying read stops immediately. This review did not rerun tests or establish full-suite, cross-platform or forced-short-read public CLI/MCP coverage.
selected.limitations_zh: 范围是既有分配/读取预算内的归档读取正确性，不宣称吞吐提升或扩大安全边界。取消测试证明取消后不发布条目，不代表每次底层读取都立即停止；本轮未重跑测试，也不补充全套、跨平台或公开CLI/MCP强制短读覆盖的结论。
diff_findings: The loop updates both buffer offset and positional file offset, then returns the fully populated buffer.
Zero bytes inside the admitted extent becomes an ArtifactReaderFailure with reason integrity.
Merged tests cover real ZIP short-read enumeration/extraction, premature EOF, allocation admission before reads, cancellation before publication and changed descriptor rejection.

selected.title: fix(process): preserve UTF-8 at diagnostic truncation boundaries
selected.author: Afloat16
selected.summary_en: Preserve UTF-8 code-point boundaries in byte-bounded diagnostic excerpts without hiding known malformed head bytes.
selected.summary_zh: 在受字节限额约束的诊断摘要中保留 UTF-8 码点边界，并保留明确损坏的头部字节证据。
selected.technical_value: Adds separate retained-head and retained-tail boundary handling to BoundedOutputExcerpt. The head drops only a suffix that could still form a valid UTF-8 code point, rejecting invalid leaders and already-invalid second-byte ranges from that trimming rule. The tail removes a possible leading continuation-byte fragment, while runs longer than three bytes remain diagnostic evidence. Untruncated output joins the retained buffers before decoding. Regression code iterates every two-chunk split, bytewise appends, malformed prefixes and subprocess stdout/stderr.
selected.limitations: A diagnostic excerpt boundary fix under the existing raw-byte budget. It is not a full UTF-8 validator, a grapheme-cluster segmenter or a promise to preserve every malformed sequence at an ambiguous tail boundary. It does not alter process-execution capabilities, exit codes, retention limits or the tail policy. Regression code was inspected; tests and cited CI were not independently rerun or verified.
selected.test_evidence: Inspected parametrized multibyte boundary tests, reconstruction without truncation, invalid/overlong/surrogate/out-of-range head prefixes, retained internal malformed bytes and a real subprocess regression covering both streams.
selected.recommendation_reason: A newer, more detailed boundary-handling example complements the existing positional ZIP short-read fix. Preserve #4524 as historical reviewed work and in the complete merged-PR inventory.
selected.source_identity_scope: PR authorship and merged state directly checked in parallel contribution audit; final commit authorship and diff independently read in this audit.
selected.technical_value_zh: 分别处理保留头尾的UTF-8截断边界：头部只移除仍可能组成合法码点的不完整后缀，明确非法的前导字节和第二字节范围保留为诊断证据；尾部跳过可能由截断产生的连续字节片段。未截断时先重接保留缓冲区再解码。合并回归逐个检查两块切分点、逐字节追加、损坏前缀以及子进程stdout/stderr。
selected.limitations_zh: 范围是既有字节预算下的诊断摘要，不是完整UTF-8校验器、字形簇分段器，也不承诺保留存在歧义的尾部边界上所有损坏序列。未改变进程执行能力、退出码、保留限额或尾部策略；本轮只读代码，未重跑测试或独立核验引用的CI。
diff_findings: Untruncated head and tail bytes are joined before UTF-8 decoding.
Head trimming excludes only a still-valid incomplete code point; invalid lead bytes, overlong/surrogate/out-of-range second-byte prefixes remain replacement-decoding evidence.
Tail trimming skips at most a possible leading continuation fragment; longer runs remain visible malformed-output evidence.
Regression code covers chunk boundaries and both subprocess streams without changing capture limits or exit-code behavior.

selected.title: Stop unchanged rebuilds after two turns across runs (R5.3)
selected.author: Afloat16
selected.summary_en: Persist rebuild progress across runs, stopping unchanged turns while preserving cancellation, recovery and new requests.
selected.summary_zh: 持久化跨运行的重建进度，在连续无变化时停止，并保留取消、恢复与新指令的正确处理。
selected.technical_value: Introduces a versioned, atomically persisted progress record and deterministic content fingerprints with bounded, cancellable traversal. Integrates before/after-turn state, check-only recovery, deferred note resets and error preservation so retries and application restarts cannot silently reset the unchanged-turn allowance. Distinguishes identical rewrites from actual file-content changes, records symlinks without following them, and caches content digests within a run.
selected.limitations: This is a file-progress guard, not a measure of semantic application improvement or model quality. Scan I/O or traversal-limit failures disable the guard for that run; record corruption or newer versions remain errors. Cache reuse relies on available file metadata. No runtime speedup, sandbox guarantee or upstream-test pass is claimed; this review did not rerun tests.
selected.test_evidence: Merged regressions cover repeated/reopened runs, single-turn runs sharing the limit, identical rewrites, manual edits, successful check-only completion, unavailable scans, cancellation, consumed notes, versioned records, traversal bounds and symlinks. Test implementations/fixtures were inspected selectively, not rerun.

selected.title: Address the parser review findings from #722 (R3.12)
selected.author: Afloat16
selected.summary_en: Correct partial Java decoding, signed DEX values, bounded AAPT string recovery and damaged ext indirect-block handling.
selected.summary_zh: 修正 Java 不完整解码、DEX 有符号数、AAPT 字符串有界恢复及 ext 损坏间接块的处理。
selected.technical_value: Five production files address four parser correctness issues found during review of maintainer integration #722. Java reference extraction preserves decoded references while surfacing incomplete bytecode decoding as partial coverage. DEX signed LEB128 decoding enforces the five-byte signed-32-bit representation and valid fifth-byte sign extension. Legacy AAPT UTF-8 recovery checks candidate lengths inside the string-data region and shares a 65,536-probe budget across the whole pool while retaining the existing output cap. Classic ext single/double-indirect traversal treats unreadable nonzero metadata as unrecovered data, keeps true sparse ranges, stops at file EOF and reports unsupported needed triple-indirect traversal.
selected.limitations: A follow-up correctness repair to existing parsers, not an original parser architecture. The ext extent-tree path is unchanged and needed triple-indirect traversal remains unsupported. Legacy UTF-8 recovery still uses lossy decoding and bounded output; this is not strict UTF-8 validation or a promise to recover arbitrary corrupt inputs. No throughput, exploit-prevention or model-quality result is claimed. Merged production changes and regression fixtures were inspected, but tests were not rerun and no final-merge CI pass was independently verified.
selected.test_evidence: Inspected regression code for partial Java instruction decoding, valid/invalid and truncated signed DEX encodings, long legacy AAPT strings bounded by pool/style regions, shared recovery-probe exhaustion, and malformed or missing ext indirect blocks without converting them to sparse file content. The final merged documentation reports a prior revision's Linux CI run, which was not independently checked here; no current-head passing claim is made.
selected.recommendation_reason: The newer change demonstrates complementary handling of parse completeness, integer-format validity, bounded recovery work and filesystem corruption. Together with #557 persistent rebuild state and #438 semantic dependency resolution, it gives the same three-item Craft row a broader and more recent production-code sample. #441 remains valid historical merged work.
selected.relationship_to_adoption_722: Direct author-merged follow-up; does not create a ninth maintainer integration or add the same original PRs again.

selected.author: Afloat16
selected.summary_en: Recover minified esbuild dependencies through semantic bindings, distinguishing shadowed and same-named wrappers.
selected.summary_zh: 基于语义绑定恢复压缩后的 esbuild 依赖，区分变量遮蔽及不同作用域中的同名包装器。
selected.technical_value: Replaces wrapper-name matching with semantic symbol keys, threads scoping information into bundle analysis, deduplicates call bindings and resolves wrapper dependencies after visiting the file. This retains dependencies after minification while avoiding false links through local parameters or similarly named wrappers in another scope.

selected.title: Make benchmark translation-angle errors invariant to reconstruction scale
selected.author: Afloat16
selected.summary_en: Make benchmark translation-angle errors invariant to reconstruction scale.
selected.summary_zh: 修正基准评估的向量归一化，使平移方向角误差不受重建尺度影响。
selected.technical_value: Normalizes finite nonzero vectors by their largest absolute component before the L2 norm, avoiding the previous small-norm floor and overflow. Merged regressions exercise independent scales from 1e-200 to 1e200, angle invariants, input preservation, zero vectors and reconstruction-level similarity transforms.
selected.technical_value_zh: 先按有限非零向量的最大绝对分量缩放，再做L2归一化，避免小范数阈值与溢出造成方向角失真；合并回归覆盖极小/极大尺度、角度不变性、输入保留、零向量以及重建级相似变换。
selected.limitations: This changes benchmark pose-error evaluation, not the reconstruction solver or reconstruction quality. The final merged test files are geometry_test.py and utils_test.py; the PR body's geometry_scale_test.py command does not describe the final filenames. Tests were not rerun during this review.
selected.limitations_zh: 范围是基准位姿误差评估，不是重建求解器或重建质量提升。最终合并测试位于geometry_test.py与utils_test.py，PR正文中的geometry_scale_test.py并非最终文件名；本轮未重跑测试。
diff_findings: normalize_vec replaces the eps-floored norm with max-component scaling and explicit zero-vector handling.
Angle tests combine independent magnitude scales and directions at 0, 45, 90 and 180 degrees.
The reconstruction-level test parametrizes Sim3d scale while scaling translation consistently.

selected.title: Preserve ranking-loss gradients with weighted log-sigmoid
selected.author: Afloat16
selected.summary_en: Preserve LambdaLoss and RankNet gradients for strongly misordered pairs using weighted log-sigmoid.
selected.summary_zh: 用加权 log-sigmoid 保留严重错排样本对的 LambdaLoss / RankNet 梯度。
selected.technical_value: Moves the weighted pairwise objective into log-probability space, avoiding probability clamps that cap large losses and suppress gradients. The merged regression compares both losses and gradients against float64 binary cross-entropy references, across score gaps, sigma values, logarithm bases and padded batches.
selected.limitations: This is objective-function correctness, not a measured ranking-accuracy or training-throughput improvement. No pretrained-model, GPU or distributed training result was verified in this review; tests were inspected but not rerun.

selected.title: Fix scalar quantization arithmetic for float16 embeddings
selected.author: Afloat16
selected.summary_en: Use float32 calibration arithmetic to prevent FP16 scalar-quantization range underflow and overflow.
selected.summary_zh: 以 float32 计算标量量化校准范围，避免 FP16 算术下溢或溢出。
selected.technical_value: The final production change casts scalar calibration ranges to float32 before computing bucket steps. It prevents narrow nonconstant FP16 ranges from collapsing to identical int8/uint8 codes and avoids overflow for large opposite-signed endpoints. Merged tests cover inferred, supplied and calibration-embedding ranges, shared multivector ranges and torch.float16 inputs.
selected.limitations: The merged code uses ranges.astype(np.float32, copy=False), not the np.result_type implementation described in the older PR body. Do not claim float64 calibration-range preservation. This is a scoped scalar-quantization fix; no new quantization algorithm, accuracy gain, accelerator result or throughput gain is claimed. Tests were not rerun.

selected.title: fix: preserve padded sequence lengths in LSTM outputs
selected.author: Afloat16
selected.summary_en: Preserve padded LSTM sequence lengths so token outputs stay aligned with companion features.
selected.summary_zh: 保留 LSTM 输出的原始填充长度，使 token 输出与其他特征维度对齐。
selected.technical_value: Passes the original padded width as total_length when unpacking packed recurrent sequences, preventing batch-dependent shortening of token_embeddings.
selected.limitations: The final merged diff contains only the production LSTM module; preparation-time regression results should not be described as tests added in the merged patch. No GPU DataParallel or model-quality improvement is claimed. Tests were not rerun in this review.

selected.title: fix: convert Milvus scores to DeepFace distance units
selected.author: Afloat16
selected.summary_en: Convert Milvus cosine-similarity and squared-L2 scores into DeepFace distance units.
selected.summary_zh: 将 Milvus 余弦相似度和平方 L2 分数转换为 DeepFace 使用的距离单位。
selected.technical_value: Repairs the vector-database adapter boundary: cosine scores become 1 minus clamped similarity; squared L2 becomes the square root of a nonnegative score. This lets existing downstream ranking, threshold and confidence logic consume distances in the units it expects. Merged unit and Milvus Lite integration regressions compare ANN and exact paths using fixed vectors.
selected.limitations: Does not change learned embeddings, face-recognition accuracy, approximate-index recall or other database adapters. Integration test code uses fixed synthetic vectors rather than learned model outputs. Tests and historical CI were not rerun or newly validated during this review.

selected.title: fix: fetch complete Milvus galleries with a query iterator
selected.author: Afloat16
selected.summary_en: Read complete Milvus galleries with a query iterator and close it on success or failure.
selected.summary_zh: 用查询迭代器完整读取 Milvus 图库，并在完成或异常时关闭迭代器。
selected.technical_value: Replaces the single query capped at 16,384 records with SDK iteration using the existing batch_size. This prevents silently omitting remaining gallery records from full-gallery reads and releases the iterator in a finally block. The merged real Milvus Lite regression inserts 16,385 records and checks every ID and the last payload.
selected.limitations: The method still accumulates all returned records in a Python list; it is not a bounded-memory streaming API or a measured throughput improvement. Scope is Milvus full-gallery reads. Test code was inspected but not rerun.

selected.limitations: Corrects the representation API's batch structure; the singleton-batch output shape intentionally changes. The merged regression uses SFace inference; no recognition-accuracy improvement is claimed. Tests were not rerun in this review.

new_candidates_reviewed.title: Stabilize loopback request and cancellation fixtures (R3.11)
new_candidates_reviewed.author: Afloat16
new_candidates_reviewed.summary_en: Make loopback-request and cancellation tests wait for the conditions they assert.
new_candidates_reviewed.summary_zh: 让回环请求及取消测试等待实际就绪和资源释放条件，减少时序偶然性。
new_candidates_reviewed.technical_value: Test fixtures wait for complete bounded HTTP headers and check the lifetime of the mock replay answerer after shutdown; the unavailable-endpoint fixture avoids a transient listener.
new_candidates_reviewed.limitations: Changes test fixtures and accompanying documentation. No production cancellation or networking fix is claimed.
new_candidates_reviewed.test_evidence: Cutter fixtures cover split request headers; stand-in cancellation observes live ownership and eventual release.

new_candidates_reviewed.title: Export Unity floating-point textures as PNG (R3.9)
new_candidates_reviewed.author: Afloat16
new_candidates_reviewed.summary_en: Export six half- and single-precision Unity texture layouts as 8-bit PNG.
new_candidates_reviewed.summary_zh: 将 Unity 的六种半精度及单精度纹理布局导出为 8 位 PNG。
new_candidates_reviewed.technical_value: The texture decoder distinguishes R, RG and RGBA samples; it converts linear RGB to sRGB, leaves alpha linear, checks required byte lengths, and handles half-float NaNs separately from infinity.
new_candidates_reviewed.limitations: The export is a clipped 8-bit visualization, not lossless HDR output. It does not add support for every Unity texture format.
new_candidates_reviewed.test_evidence: Known pixel bytes and sizes for all six layouts, truncation, channel order, alpha and nonfinite/extreme samples.

new_candidates_reviewed.title: Report malformed ClientHello offers and retain unknown TLS versions (R3.12)
new_candidates_reviewed.author: Afloat16
new_candidates_reviewed.summary_en: Detect malformed TLS ClientHello offers while preserving unknown version values.
new_candidates_reviewed.summary_zh: 标出畸形 TLS ClientHello 提议，同时保留未识别的版本值。
new_candidates_reviewed.technical_value: The packet parser checks variable-length offers, marks duplicate or inconsistent extensions as partial, and continues validating ALPN after reaching the retained-output cap. Only reserved GREASE values receive that label.
new_candidates_reviewed.limitations: A passive capture parser, not a TLS endpoint or a security/protocol-conformance certification.
new_candidates_reviewed.test_evidence: Regression records vary session, cipher, compression, SNI, ALPN and supported-version vectors.

new_candidates_reviewed.title: Read DNS service records and retain questionless address announcements (R3.12)
new_candidates_reviewed.author: Afloat16
new_candidates_reviewed.summary_en: Decode bounded DNS service records and retain addresses from questionless replies.
new_candidates_reviewed.summary_zh: 解析有边界的 DNS 服务记录，并保留不含 question 的应答地址。
new_candidates_reviewed.technical_value: The reader validates type-specific RDATA, including SOA, SRV and CAA; separates mDNS name/compression and class handling where needed, and uses the answer owner when a reply has no question.
new_candidates_reviewed.limitations: Summarizes observed packets, not a DNS resolver or full protocol implementation; incomplete observations remain identified.
new_candidates_reviewed.test_evidence: Bounded names, empty update prerequisites, address sizes, service records and multicast/questionless replies.

new_candidates_reviewed.title: Bound malformed pcapng records and preserve capture timestamp precision (R3.12)
new_candidates_reviewed.author: Afloat16
new_candidates_reviewed.summary_en: Charge malformed pcapng packet records to the scan budget and handle invalid timestamp fractions explicitly.
new_candidates_reviewed.summary_zh: 将畸形 pcapng 包记录计入扫描预算，并显式处理非法时间戳小数部分。
new_candidates_reviewed.technical_value: Rejected packet blocks with overflowing data extents or unknown interfaces now consume the same packet budget as accepted records. The parser aggregates warning reasons, withholds invalid classic-PCAP timestamps, and handles subnanosecond decimal resolutions without discarding a valid zero fractional result.
new_candidates_reviewed.limitations: Bounds the handled packet records, not every byte or every pcapng block type. Timestamps remain integer nanoseconds; no timing-precision benchmark is claimed.
new_candidates_reviewed.test_evidence: Embedded capture regressions exercise malformed budgets, warning aggregation, invalid fractions and extreme timestamp resolution.

new_candidates_reviewed.title: Launch Go apps with a single command package (R2.7)
new_candidates_reviewed.author: Afloat16
new_candidates_reviewed.summary_en: Launch a Go project from a single cmd/*/main.go entrypoint without guessing between commands.
new_candidates_reviewed.summary_zh: 识别唯一的 cmd/*/main.go 启动 Go 项目；遇到多个命令入口时不猜测。
new_candidates_reviewed.technical_value: The bounded directory scan only selects an unambiguous command package and supplies it as a separate go run argument, keeping the root main.go recipe first.
new_candidates_reviewed.limitations: Recognizes a specific layout with a bounded scan, not arbitrary recursive Go package discovery.
new_candidates_reviewed.test_evidence: One command, ambiguous command directories and precedence of a root entrypoint.

new_candidates_reviewed.title: Keep system tools and media players on the app build path (R2.7)
new_candidates_reviewed.author: Afloat16
new_candidates_reviewed.summary_en: Keep system tools and single-player media applications on the application build path.
new_candidates_reviewed.summary_zh: 避免把系统工具和单播放器媒体应用误判为游戏构建任务。
new_candidates_reviewed.technical_value: Refines word boundaries, normalized whitespace and contextual checks around level/player terms without losing explicit game examples.
new_candidates_reviewed.limitations: A targeted request-routing heuristic; no general classification accuracy benchmark.
new_candidates_reviewed.test_evidence: Contrasts MPEG/media and low-/high-level system requests with real player counts and game-related requests.

new_candidates_reviewed.title: fix(fs): identify SVG by its document root
new_candidates_reviewed.author: Afloat16
new_candidates_reviewed.summary_en: Identify SVG from the first XML element in a bounded file prefix.
new_candidates_reviewed.summary_zh: 在有限文件头内识别首个 XML 元素，避免将嵌套或注释中的 SVG 当成文档根。
new_candidates_reviewed.technical_value: The file classifier skips declarations, processing instructions, comments and doctypes; the doctype scanner tracks quoted text and internal-subset depth before checking the document root.
new_candidates_reviewed.limitations: A bounded MIME classifier, not a general XML validator or SVG sanitizer.
new_candidates_reviewed.test_evidence: Positive prologs and self-closing roots, negative nested/comment/CDATA examples and incomplete prefixes.

new_candidates_reviewed.title: Restore bearing-aware cheirality for DLT triangulation
new_candidates_reviewed.author: Afloat16
new_candidates_reviewed.summary_en: Restore bearing-aligned cheirality checks for spherical-camera DLT triangulation.
new_candidates_reviewed.summary_zh: 用观测射线判断双视图 DLT 三角化的正深度，正确处理球面相机的后半球观测。
new_candidates_reviewed.technical_value: The reconstructed point must have a positive dot product with each observed bearing in its own camera frame. This accepts valid rear-hemisphere points and rejects antipodal rays even when their projective DLT constraints coincide.
new_candidates_reviewed.limitations: Changes the oriented-depth validity test, not the linear triangulation solver or a measured reconstruction-accuracy result.
new_candidates_reviewed.test_evidence: Spherical projection/unprojection, opposed and rotated cameras, scaled rays, antipodal pixels and noisy image points exercise both entry points.

new_candidates_reviewed.title: Preserve fenced examples and single-quoted links in README translations
new_candidates_reviewed.author: Afloat16
new_candidates_reviewed.summary_en: Keep example code unchanged and rewrite single-quoted HTML links in translated READMEs.
new_candidates_reviewed.summary_zh: 翻译 README 时保留代码示例原样，并正确重写单引号 HTML 链接。
new_candidates_reviewed.technical_value: A Markdown parser supplies code-block source line ranges instead of toggling on fence-looking strings; quote-aware attribute rewrites preserve the original delimiters for href, src and srcset.
new_candidates_reviewed.limitations: Affects the README translation utility, not runtime memory or model behavior.
new_candidates_reviewed.test_evidence: Nested/list fences, mismatched lengths and delimiters, literal markers and quoted link variants.

new_candidates_reviewed.title: fix(metrics): accumulate half-precision meter updates in float32
new_candidates_reviewed.author: Afloat16
new_candidates_reviewed.summary_en: Accumulate weighted float16 and bfloat16 meter updates in float32 while retaining the original last value.
new_candidates_reviewed.summary_zh: 在乘以权重前将半精度张量提升为 float32 累加，保留最近一次输入的原值和类型。
new_candidates_reviewed.technical_value: Promotion happens before weighting, preventing avoidable FP16 overflow and low-precision running-sum loss. Other input types keep their existing promotion behavior.
new_candidates_reviewed.limitations: Applies to AverageMeter's running totals; no training-accuracy or performance benchmark.
new_candidates_reviewed.test_evidence: Repeated low-precision additions, weighted large values, last-value identity and gradients.

new_candidates_reviewed.title: fix(image): export bfloat16 Image data to NumPy
new_candidates_reviewed.author: Afloat16
new_candidates_reviewed.summary_en: Export bfloat16 images to NumPy as float32 while preserving the stored layout.
new_candidates_reviewed.summary_zh: 将 bfloat16 图像复制为 NumPy 可表示的 float32 数组，保留原有通道布局。
new_candidates_reviewed.technical_value: Only the unsupported bfloat16 NumPy export needs a dtype conversion; the image object and its metadata remain intact, and supported CPU data can retain shared storage.
new_candidates_reviewed.limitations: The bfloat16 path copies; it is not zero-copy, and does not change the stored tensor dtype or DLPack format.
new_candidates_reviewed.test_evidence: Tests grayscale/RGB, channels-first/last, values, metadata and memory sharing or independence.

prior_record.title: Compare WebAssembly exported tag parameter types (R0.5)
prior_record.author: Afloat16
prior_record.summary_en: Compare imported and defined WebAssembly tag signatures while preserving index spaces and truncation diagnostics.
prior_record.summary_zh: 比较导入与本地定义的 WebAssembly 标签签名，并保持索引空间与截断诊断的正确性。
prior_record.technical_value: Adds tag metadata to the binary report, resolves exported tags to function signatures, and tracks the imported-tag index independently of capped import/tag lists. prior_record.title: fix(browser): reject invalid UTF-8 in HTTP CDP discovery
prior_record.author: Afloat16
prior_record.summary_en: Reject malformed UTF-8 before HTTP CDP discovery JSON decoding, while preserving valid Unicode.
prior_record.summary_zh: 在HTTP CDP发现响应解析为JSON前拒绝损坏的UTF-8，并保留有效Unicode内容。
prior_record.technical_value: Validates the complete size-bounded response buffer with node:buffer.isUtf8 before replacement-prone decoding. The merged regression suite distinguishes malformed title/URL bytes from a legitimate U+FFFD character, verifies multibyte text split across HTTP chunks and checks recovery on the next discovery.
prior_record.technical_value_zh: 先对已收齐且受大小限制的响应字节进行node:buffer.isUtf8校验，再解码，防止损坏字节被替换后伪装成有效标题或URL。合并回归区分非法字节与合法U+FFFD，覆盖跨HTTP分块的多字节文本以及后续发现请求恢复。
prior_record.limitations: A scoped HTTP discovery validation fix; it does not change WebSocket framing, endpoint authorization, provider capabilities or public command/schema shape. Malformed UTF-8 now produces the existing invalid_endpoint_response error. Tests use simulated loopback HTTP producers, not a qualified real-browser or packaged-install run. No performance improvement is claimed and tests were not rerun in this review.
prior_record.limitations_zh: 这是限定于HTTP发现响应的校验修复，不涉及WebSocket帧、端点授权、新提供方或公开命令/模式变更；损坏UTF-8返回既有invalid_endpoint_response。测试使用回环HTTP模拟服务，不等于真实浏览器或打包安装验证。本轮未重跑测试，不宣称性能提升。
diff_findings: Imports isUtf8 and validates Buffer.concat(chunks, bytes) after the response ends and before toString('utf8')/JSON parsing.
Uses the existing invalid_endpoint_response error and returns before decoding malformed bytes.
Merged tests cover invalid target-title and URL bytes, recovery after rejection, a literal replacement character, split multibyte text and preservation of BOM rejection.
